einzeiler: Joe Rogan, Shane Gillis and Ari Shaffir discuss comedy struggles, history, and pop…
kurzfassung: Joe Rogan sits down with comedians Shane Gillis and Ari Shaffir for another round of Protect Our Parks. The group dives into a wide range of topics, including Ari's recent comedy struggles in England and travels in Tunisia. They also share stories about legendary boxing matches, historic disasters, and the realities of modern fame.
stichpunkte: Ari Shaffir shares his experiences bombing on stage and traveling through England and Tunisia.
The group discusses historical atrocities, eugenics boards, and ancient Roman rulers.
They analyze famous sports moments, including the greatest calls in sports history.
The conversation turns to the challenges and realities of being a comedian and handling internet backlash.
They share encounters and stories about various actors and public figures.
The hosts discuss endurance runners like David Goggins and an individual who walked across the world.
They touch upon conspiracy theories, including 4chan pranks and QAnon documentaries.
